tenders.title: Aberdeen Destination Marketing, Development and Convention Bureau Service
tenders.description: Aberdeen City Council is seeking to appoint a single contractor to provide an integrated, city-focused Destination Marketing, Development and Convention Bureau Service for Aberdeen. The Service will support the objectives of the Aberdeen Visitor Levy and the sustainable growth of Aberdeen’s visitor economy. It will include destination marketing and communications, destination development, travel-trade activity, visitor information and welcome services, visitor-economy business engagement, Convention Bureau services, administration of a ring-fenced Convention Bureau Subvention Fund, research, evaluation, data and performance reporting. The Contract will be for an initial period of three years, with an option for the Council to extend it by up to a further two years. The anticipated commencement date is 1 April 2027.

tenders.title: Promote Shetland Service 2027–2032
tenders.description: The role of Promote Shetland is to provide an effective promotional gateway for Shetland, support collaboration among public, private, community, education and third-sector stakeholders, and protect and develop a strong, authentic and positive place brand for Shetland as a place to live, work, study, visit and invest. Tenderers should take account of Shetland’s island geography, transport links, demographic challenges, economic opportunities and the need for targeted, evidence-led promotion.

tenders.title: Glasgow Business Growth Framework - Phase 4
tenders.description: Glasgow City Council (the Council) requires a framework of suppliers to deliver a range of business growth consultancy services to eligible organisations across the city to aide a sustainable growth agenda and improve business start-up and survival rates. As the organisations accessing support via this Framework have different needs, the services provided must be offered flexibly. This includes, but is not limited to, face to face, digitally, by phone and one to one at suitable times and locations. tenders.title: Computerised Maintenance Management System (CMMS) / Computer-Aided Facility Management System (CAFM)
tenders.description: The NHS Grampian Maintenance & Technical Services (MaTS) Department is responsible for the management and maintenance of a diverse estate throughout Aberdeen City, Aberdeenshire and Moray, ranging from small healthcare facilities to large acute hospital sites. The Authority requires a CMMS/CAFM Solution capable of supporting the effective administration and control of assets, maintenance activities, compliance activities, contractor activities, reporting requirements and associated operational, governance and assurance processes.
